newsitem.title: USA: Ambanc to open second Terre Haute office.
newsitem.headline: Ambanc to open second Terre Haute office.

text.p: Ambanc Indiana, a unit of Ambanc Corp, said Tuesday it will build a second branch banking office in Terre Haute, Indiana, that is expected to open for business in the first quarter of 1998.

Ambanc Indiana officials said the economic climate in the area and the potential for growth warrants opening the new facility, which will be added to a roster of 15 branches currently operating in five Indiana counties.
Ambanc is a bank holding company with assets of more than $725 million and 25 banking offices in southwest Indiana and southeast Illinois.
